description: The Cubicle plans as plan cards (offers: the label, the price from the ledger, the allowance, what each opens, and whether it is the caller's own plan, held or offered, with its checkout) and exactly how to pay on Robinhood Chain in USDG: the treasury, the token, and, when the subscription vault is live, the two wallet transactions (approve, subscribe) that renew automatically every 30 days. Nothing here moves money: the trader signs in their own wallet. Show the person the offers as they are: never retype a price or a plan name.

plan.description: a plan id from offers[].id to prepare the payment steps for

wallet.description: the 0x address of the wallet that will pay — needed for the renewing subscription, which is authorized for that wallet only

name: plans
